Heavy and consistent.

Aerodynamic and light.

  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.desc: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Sneak Bow
perks.desc: Increases hold time and reload speed, and prevents radar pings from shooting while crouched.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.desc: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.desc: Arrows explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.desc: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

notes: [YeezyGT's S18] [MW: Draw/Reload] "Fantastic Bow. Uses the Wolftone Draw-style model, with a stellar perk pool. Includes fan favourite Incandescent, Explosive Head, Vorpal for Champions, the list goes on. Excellently replaces the sub-par Solar Bow from Last Wish." tags:pve

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Similar to all other bows the best in slot perks are archer’s tempo and either vorpal weapon or explosive head. Overload bow loves explosive head." Recommended MW - Accuracy or Draw Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Precision frames are some of the better choices for bows in PvP. Strident Whistle would need to have the lowest charge time of 576 to even compete in PvP. Fiberglass arrow shaft brings the accuracy back up after elastic string lowers it. Archer’s tempo is still great here, as is explosive head for double flinch. Moving target is a great pick if you feel you use your bow for follow up shots instead of bow-swap. Successful warm-up paired with archer’s tempo is incredible for some really fast draw times, but it feels almost “kill clip-esque” with successful warm-up needing a kill to activate." Recommended MW - Accuracy or Draw Time.

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 20. PvE first choice roll for end-game add clear or use against champions, and is the only solar precision bow that drops (as at Season 17) in game. The Vanguard's Vindication origin trait is useful, if unspectacular. As ever, use Elastic String to get the draw time as low as possible, Straight Fletching to recover the lost accuracy, and Archer's Tempo to speed up follow-up shots. Then Explosive Head adds flinch, damage and extends useful range, and improves performance against champions. Recommended MW: Draw Time, with a damage-boosting (Minor, Major or Taken Spec) mod.
